sentences.en: She is above any of her classmates in speaking English.
sentences.zh: 她的英语水平在所有同学之上。

sentences.en: The brightest student expressed gratitude on behalf of his classmates.
sentences.zh: 班里最聪明的学生代表同学们表示感谢。

sentences.en: Some of my classmates like volleyball and others enjoy tennis.
sentences.zh: 有的同学喜欢排球，有的则喜欢网球。
